declarations.type:

  (R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D) (A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R)
  (P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R)
  {states : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions D R A P states →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
      ∀ ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
        ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →
          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
            ∀ (wc wg wv : ℝ),
              0 ≤ wc →
                0 ≤ wg →
                  0 ≤ wv →
                    ((∑ i,
                                    if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then
                                      (P.potential K).groupStrain i / (P.potential K).groupBalance i * wc +
                                          (P.potential K).groupKappa i / 2 * (P.potential K).length *
                                                (P.potential K).groupGrad i /
                                              (P.potential K).groupBalance i *
                                            wg +
                                        (P.potential K).groupKappa i / 2 * (P.potential K).groupGrad i /
                                            ((P.potential K).length * (P.potential K).groupBalance i) *
                                          wv
                                    else 0) +
                                  if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then
                                    (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι * wc + (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι * wg +
                                      (A.blocks K).leakVel ι * wv
                                  else 0) +
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.creditVelDemand D R K ι p * wv +
                              (if ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K then R.pairSlackWeight K ι else 0) * wg +
                            (if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                                (P.potential K).epsStrain +
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                      (P.potential K).longStrain +
                                  (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl
                              else 0) *
                              wc +
                          (if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                              3 / (2 * √2) *
                                (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                        (P.potential K).longGrad) *
                                    (P.potential K).epsLength +
                                  (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngVel)
                            else 0) *
                            wg +
                        (if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                            3 / (2 * √2) *
                              (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                      (P.potential K).longGrad) /
                                  (P.potential K).length +
                                (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngStrain)
                          else 0) *
                          wv ≤
                      (R.entryCharges K ι).curlCharge p * wc + (R.entryCharges K ι).gradCharge p * wg +
                        (R.entryCharges K ι).velCharge p * wv

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM) (q : Fin k → ℝ)
  (mc : Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCharges) (ec : Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.EntryCharges) (ι : ℤ × ℤ)
  (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
  (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
  D.labelDensity q v G H ι p -
      Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.offModeDensity (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn mc ec
        D.azimuthOrder ι v G H p =
    (mc.curl ι p + ec.curlCharge p) *
            √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad D.azimuthOrder ι G p))) ^ 2 +
          (ec.stretchConst * mc.gradient ι p * mc.length ι p / 2 + ec.gradCharge p) *
            √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad D.azimuthOrder ι G p)) ^ 2 +
        (ec.stretchConst * mc.gradient ι p * (mc.length ι p)⁻¹ / 2 + ec.velCharge p) *
          √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι v p)) ^ 2 +
      ec.stretchConst * mc.product ι p *
        (√(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad D.azimuthOrder ι G p)) *
          √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι v p)))

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM)
  (R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D) (A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R)
  (P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R)
  {states : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions D R A P states →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
      ∀ ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
        ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space),
          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
            ((((((((((if ι ∈ D.mesh.band K then
                                        p.1 *
                                          ∑ j,
                                            (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι j *
                                              ‖Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p j‖ ^ 2
                                      else 0) +
                                      if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then
                                        p.1 *
                                          ((A.blocks K).leakCurl ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeCurlSq D ι G p +
                                            (A.blocks K).leakVel ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeVelSq D ι v p)
                                      else 0) +
                                    if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then
                                      p.1 *
                                        ((A.blocks K).leakStrain ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeStrainSq D ι G p)
                                    else 0) +
                                  ∑ i,
                                    (if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then
                                        p.1 *
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.groupCharge (P.potential K) i
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradOf
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                                      else 0) /
                                      (P.potential K).groupBalance i +
                                if ι ∈ D.mesh.band K then
                                  p.1 *
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.epsPartnerCharge (P.potential K)
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradOf
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                                else 0) +
                              if ι ∈ D.mesh.band K then
                                p.1 *
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longPartnerCharge (P.potential K) ι
                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradOf
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                              else 0) +
                            if ι ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactPartners D R K (P.potential K) then
                              p.1 *
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.epsPartnerCharge (P.potential K)
                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf
                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradOf
                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                            else 0) +
                          if ι ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactPartners D R K (P.potential K) then
                            p.1 *
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longPartnerCharge (P.potential K) ι
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradOf (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                          else 0) +
                        if ι ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactPartners D R K (P.potential K) then
                          p.1 *
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.highPartnerCharge (P.potential K)
                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p)
                        else 0) +
                      if ι ∈ D.mesh.band K then
                        p.1 *
                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.highPartnerCharge (P.potential K)
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p)
                      else 0) +
                    if ι ∈ D.mesh.band K then
                      p.1 *
                        ((A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeCurlSq D ι G p +
                          (A.blocks K).bandVelAllowance ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeVelSq D ι v p)
                    else 0) +
                  p.1 *
                    ((if ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K then R.pairSlackWeight K ι else 0) *
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeStrainSq D ι G p) +
                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.creditVelDemand D R K ι p * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeVelSq D ι v p *
                  p.1 ≤

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.actuatorPairing_of_solenoidal_and_gradient
declarations.type:
(∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (w : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM) (P : ℝ) (h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds)
    (wt : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) (Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
    (HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
    {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
    Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.IsAdmissibleWeak w P h wt W HW w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
      ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
        (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
        (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
        Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
          ∀ (M : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
            w.IsMultiplierField v G H M →
              ∀ (ψ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                (ContDiff ℝ 1 fun z => ψ z.1 z.2) →
                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic ψ →
                    (∃ R, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), R < ‖y‖ → ψ σ y = 0) →
                      (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (ψ σ) y = 0) →
                        Breakdown.periodPairing ψ M = Breakdown.CertCell.multiplierRight w v G H ψ) →
  (∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (w : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM) (P : ℝ) (h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds)
      (wt : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) (Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
      (HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
      {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
      Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.IsAdmissibleWeak w P h wt W HW w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
        ∀ (b : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
          Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.ActuatorFacts w b →
            ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
              (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
              (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
              (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
              Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
                ∀ (M : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                  w.IsMultiplierField v G H M →
                    ∀ (ε : ℝ),
                      0 < ε →
                        ∃ ψ,
                          (ContDiff ℝ 1 fun z => ψ z.1 z.2) ∧
                            Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic ψ ∧
                              (∃ R, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), R < ‖y‖ → ψ σ y = 0) ∧
                                (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (ψ σ) y = 0) ∧
                                  |Breakdown.periodPairing b M - Breakdown.periodPairing ψ M| +
                                      |Breakdown.CertCell.multiplierRight w v G H b -
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.multiplierRight w v G H ψ| <
                                    ε) →
    Breakdown.CertCell.ActuatorPairingHolds

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.Internal.groupCrossBound
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM)
  (R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D) (A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R)
  (P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R)
  {states : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions D R A P states →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (B : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
      (∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
          ∀ β ∈ B,
            -β ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelLabels D K →
              ι + β ∉ D.mesh.resolved K →
                ι + β ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                  ∃ i,
                    ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupModes i ∧
                      ι + β ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i ∧ β ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics i) →
        (∀ (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount), (P.potential K).groupHarmonics i ⊆ B) →
          (∀ (i j : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
              ∀ β ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics i, β ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics j → i = j) →
            ∀ (X Y : ℤ × ℤ → (Fin 3 → ℂ) × (Fin 3 × Fin 3 → ℂ)),
              ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                2 *
                    ‖∑ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                        ∑ β ∈ B,
                          if ι + β ∉ D.mesh.resolved K ∧ ι + β ∉ D.mesh.band K then
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelTriple
                              (fun a b => D.model.strain.planeValue D.mesh.box K β a b p)
                              (fun a b => D.model.vorticityGrad.planeValue D.mesh.box K β a b p) (X ι).1 (X ι).2
                              (star (Y (ι + β)).1) (star (Y (ι + β)).2)
                          else 0‖ ≤
                  ∑ i,
                    (((P.potential K).groupBalance i *
                        ∑ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                          if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupModes i then
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.groupCharge (P.potential K) i (X ι).1 (X ι).2
                          else 0) +
                      ((P.potential K).groupBalance i)⁻¹ *
                        ∑ ι' ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i,
                          if ι' ∉ D.mesh.resolved K ∧ ι' ∉ D.mesh.band K then
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.groupCharge (P.potential K) i (Y ι').1 (Y ι').2
                          else 0)

∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM)
  (R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D) (A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R)
  (P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R)
  {states : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions D R A P states →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
      (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space),
      ∀ ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
        MeasureTheory.Integrable
            (fun p =>
              p.1 * ∑ j, (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι j * ‖Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p j‖ ^ 2)
            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) →
          MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun p =>
                p.1 *
                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.epsPartnerCharge (P.potential K)
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradOf (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p)))
              (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable
                (fun p =>
                  p.1 *
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longPartnerCharge (P.potential K) ι
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradOf (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p)))
                (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) →
              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                  (fun p =>
                    p.1 *
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.highPartnerCharge (P.potential K)
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                  (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) →
                MeasureTheory.Integrable
                    (fun p =>
                      p.1 *
                        ((A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeCurlSq D ι G p +
                          (A.blocks K).bandVelAllowance ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeVelSq D ι v p))
                    (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) →
                  MeasureTheory.Integrable
                      (fun p =>
                        p.1 *
                          ((A.blocks K).leakCurl ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeCurlSq D ι G p +
                            (A.blocks K).leakVel ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeVelSq D ι v p))
                      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) →
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                        (fun p => p.1 * ((A.blocks K).leakStrain ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeStrainSq D ι G p))
                        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) →
                      (∀ (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                          MeasureTheory.Integrable
                            (fun p =>
                              p.1 *
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.groupCharge (P.potential K) i
                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf
                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradOf
                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p)))
                            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect)) →
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable
                            (fun p =>
                              p.1 *
                                ((if ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K then R.pairSlackWeight K ι else 0) *
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeStrainSq D ι G p))
                            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) →
                          MeasureTheory.Integrable
                              (fun p =>
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.creditVelDemand D R K ι p *
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeVelSq D ι v p *
                                  p.1)
                              (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) →
                            MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                (fun p => Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.extraChargeDensity D R K ι v G p * p.1)
                                (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) →
                              (((((((((((if ι ∈ D.mesh.band K then
                                                          ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                            p.1 *
                                                              ∑ j,
                                                                (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι j *
                                                                  ‖Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p
                                                                        j‖ ^
                                                                    2
                                                        else 0) +
                                                        if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then
                                                          ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                            p.1 *
                                                              ((A.blocks K).leakCurl ι *
                                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeCurlSq D ι G p +
                                                                (A.blocks K).leakVel ι *
                                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeVelSq D ι v p)
                                                        else 0) +
                                                      if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then
                                                        ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                          p.1 *
                                                            ((A.blocks K).leakStrain ι *
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeStrainSq D ι G p)
                                                      else 0) +
                                                    ∑ i,
                                                      (if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then

                    Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.offModeDensity (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)

      (A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R) (P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R)
      {states : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions D R A P states →
        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (Xp Yp : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ × ℝ → Fin 12 → ℂ),

                p.1 *

                      if ι + β ∉ D.mesh.resolved K ∧ ι + β ∉ D.mesh.band K then
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelTriple
                          (fun a b => D.model.strain.planeValue D.mesh.box K β a b p)
                          (fun a b => D.model.vorticityGrad.planeValue D.mesh.box K β a b p)
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf (Xp ι p)) (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradOf (Xp ι p))
                          (star (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf (Yp (ι + β) p)))

                      else 0).re

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.Internal.deactivatedPointwise
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM)
  (R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D) (A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R)
  (P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R)
  {states : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions D R A P states →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
      ∀ ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
        ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →
          ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
            (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space),
            ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
              (((((if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then
                                p.1 *
                                  ((A.blocks K).leakCurl ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeCurlSq D ι G p +
                                    (A.blocks K).leakVel ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeVelSq D ι v p)
                              else 0) +
                              if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then
                                p.1 * ((A.blocks K).leakStrain ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeStrainSq D ι G p)
                              else 0) +
                            ∑ i,
                              (if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then
                                  p.1 *
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.groupCharge (P.potential K) i
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradOf
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                                else 0) /
                                (P.potential K).groupBalance i +
                          if ι ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactPartners D R K (P.potential K) then
                            p.1 *
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.epsPartnerCharge (P.potential K)
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradOf (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                          else 0) +
                        if ι ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactPartners D R K (P.potential K) then
                          p.1 *
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longPartnerCharge (P.potential K) ι
                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.velOf (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradOf (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p))
                        else 0) +
                      if ι ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactPartners D R K (P.potential K) then
                        p.1 *
                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.highPartnerCharge (P.potential K)
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandProfile D ι v G p)
                      else 0) +
                    p.1 *
                      ((if ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K then R.pairSlackWeight K ι else 0) *
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeStrainSq D ι G p) +
                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.creditVelDemand D R K ι p *
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modeVelSq D ι v p *
                    p.1 ≤
                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.extraChargeDensity D R K ι v G p * p.1

            ∑ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
              ((P.potential K).strainBalance ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.tailStrainSq D R K ι G +
                (P.potential K).velBalance ι * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.tailVelSq D R K ι v) +

        ∑ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
